# Transforming Manufacturing for a Better Future


[Learn more][189]

## The Broadest 3D Printing Portfolio, Built for High-Performance Industries

With deep expertise, we guide you toward smarter, leaner, and more scalable manufacturing.
[A group of 3D Systems 3D Printers]
3D Printers
The industry's most comprehensive range of commercial 3D printers, enabling companies to print
plastic or metal parts at the point-of-need in a fraction of the time compared to traditional
manufacturing processes.
[View all 3D printers][190]
[A group of 3D printed materials]
Materials
Explore our extensive and versatile portfolio of 3D printing materials including plastic, elastomer,
composite, wax, metal, bio-compatible, and more.
[View all materials][191]
[A desktop computer next to a 3D printed part, as shown on the desktop]
Software
Streamline innovation and boost efficiency from design to production with our AI-powered software.
Tailored for precision in additive manufacturing, our software is ideal for industrial and
healthcare applications.
[View our software][192]
[A person holding a 3D printed impeller made from Direct Metal Printing]
Work with our Application Innovation Group
Our dedicated team of application innovation experts guide you from exploration to full-scale
production through a full range of consultative services aimed to help you accelerate and de-risk
adoption of additive.
[Work with our 3D printing experts][193]

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Intravenous Vascular Access Trainer

## Ultrasound Guided IV Access System

Simulab's Ultrasound Guided IV Access Arm System is an easy-to-use and anatomically correct task
trainer for ultrasound guided peripheral intravenous cannulation, and peripheral line placement.
[ Learn More ][274]
Trauma Training Surgical Simulator

## TraumaMan System
## Now with Ultrasound for Pericardiocentesis and Hemothorax

The TraumaMan® System, used in ATLS worldwide since 2001, is an anatomically correct human patient
simulator that allows students to practice a variety of advanced surgical procedures. Its flexible
design and replaceable tissues give each student a "first cut" experience and make it easy to
incorporate into team trauma training.
[ TraumaMan System ][275] [ NEW: Ultrasound Module ][276]
Complete Infant Airway Management Trainer

## AirwayBaby Trainer

Simulab's AirwayBaby Infant Airway Management Trainer is a soft tissue trainer that simulates a 0-6
month old infant. The trainer delivers realistic and fully immersive training of oral and nasal
intubation.
[ Learn More ][277]
Realistic Ultrasound Pericardiocentesis

## Ultrasound Guided Pericardiocentesis Trainer

Simulab's Ultrasound Guided Pericardiocentesis Trainer provides realistic task training under
ultrasound. Practice needle and catheter insertion into the pericardial space, and drainage of the
pericardial fluid. This easy-to-use trainer includes all relevant palpable and ultrasoundable
anatomy.
[ Learn More ][278]
Temporary Transvenous Cardiac Pacing

## PacerMan Training System

The PacerMan® System allows learners to practice emergent transvenous pacing and right heart
catheterization scenarios. This high-fidelity ultrasound compatible trainer includes real-time
feedback on the simulated patient monitor and ECG strip — the only trainer for training transvenous
pacing from catheter insertion to capture.
[ Learn More ][279]

## Simulab Corporation

Simulab is dedicated to replicating human anatomy, and building realistic, easy-to-use training
tools for healthcare simulation.

By collaborating closely with leading educators worldwide, leveraging our over 25 years of
experience and constantly pushing the boundaries of realistic tissue discovery, Simulab has become
the market leader for realistic and affordable trainers for a vast array of healthcare simulation
models.

Ultrasound-Guided Hemothorax and Pericardiocentesis

TraumaMan System Ultrasound Module

The standard of practice for emergency trauma has evolved. Simulab's Ultrasound Module for the
TraumaMan Surgical Training System adds ultrasound-guided pericardiocentesis and ultrasound-guided
hemothorax to your training workflow.

Intravenous Vascular Access Trainer

## Ultrasound Guided IV Access System

Simulab's Ultrasound Guided IV Access Arm System is an easy-to-use and anatomically correct task
trainer for ultrasound guided peripheral intravenous cannulation, and peripheral line placement.
[ Learn More ][274]
Trauma Training Surgical Simulator

## TraumaMan System
## Now with Ultrasound for Pericardiocentesis and Hemothorax

The TraumaMan® System, used in ATLS worldwide since 2001, is an anatomically correct human patient
simulator that allows students to practice a variety of advanced surgical procedures. Its flexible
design and replaceable tissues give each student a "first cut" experience and make it easy to
incorporate into team trauma training.
[ TraumaMan System ][275] [ NEW: Ultrasound Module ][276]
Complete Infant Airway Management Trainer

## AirwayBaby Trainer

Simulab's AirwayBaby Infant Airway Management Trainer is a soft tissue trainer that simulates a 0-6
month old infant. The trainer delivers realistic and fully immersive training of oral and nasal
intubation.
[ Learn More ][277]
Realistic Ultrasound Pericardiocentesis

## Ultrasound Guided Pericardiocentesis Trainer

Simulab's Ultrasound Guided Pericardiocentesis Trainer provides realistic task training under
ultrasound. Practice needle and catheter insertion into the pericardial space, and drainage of the
pericardial fluid. This easy-to-use trainer includes all relevant palpable and ultrasoundable
anatomy.
[ Learn More ][278]
Temporary Transvenous Cardiac Pacing

## PacerMan Training System

The PacerMan® System allows learners to practice emergent transvenous pacing and right heart
catheterization scenarios. This high-fidelity ultrasound compatible trainer includes real-time
feedback on the simulated patient monitor and ECG strip — the only trainer for training transvenous
pacing from catheter insertion to capture.
[ Learn More ][279]

## Simulab Corporation

Simulab is dedicated to replicating human anatomy, and building realistic, easy-to-use training
tools for healthcare simulation.

By collaborating closely with leading educators worldwide, leveraging our over 25 years of
experience and constantly pushing the boundaries of realistic tissue discovery, Simulab has become
the market leader for realistic and affordable trainers for a vast array of healthcare simulation
models.

Ultrasound-Guided Hemothorax and Pericardiocentesis

TraumaMan System Ultrasound Module

The standard of practice for emergency trauma has evolved. Simulab's Ultrasound Module for the
TraumaMan Surgical Training System adds ultrasound-guided pericardiocentesis and ultrasound-guided
hemothorax to your training workflow.

## Apprendi, Esercitati, Migliora.

Specialisti nella crescita delle competenze

La nostra offerta formativa è pensata per chi desidera trarre il meglio dai percorsi educativi e
potenziare le proprie competenze, per garantire la massima sicurezza dei pazienti. Ogni corso è
progettato per offrire non solo **crediti formativi ECM**, ma anche un **apprendimento altamente
interattivo**, mirato e all’avanguardia.

**Andiamo oltre la teoria**: grazie alla simulazione, offriamo la possibilità di sperimentare
procedure in modo realistico, perfezionare ogni gesto in un ambiente controllato per imparare a
prendere decisioni critiche sotto pressione. La simulazione è l’unica tecnica che riproduce
fedelmente le dinamiche e le sfide dei contesti reali, **con la possibilità di sbagliare, correggere
e migliorare senza conseguenze**.

## La nostra tecnologia al servizio della formazione

Ricerca, sviluppo e servizi per la simulazione avanzata

La simulazione avanzata è la nuova frontiera dell’addestramento in medicina. Offriamo soluzioni
all’avanguardia per la simulazione medica, pensate per potenziare le competenze dei professionisti
sanitari, garantire cure di eccellenza e contribuire alla sicurezza dei pazienti. Grazie
all’esperienza maturata in oltre 15 anni di attività, siamo esperti nella progettazione e gestione
integrata dei centri di simulazione per formazione continua dei professionisti sanitari. Offriamo
soluzioni personalizzate e studiate su misura per le esigenze di ciascun cliente. Grazie al nostro
team di ricerca e sviluppo, impegnato ogni giorno per migliorare i prodotti e i servizi,
contribuiamo a ridefinire gli standard della simulazione medica a livello internazionale.

### Collaborazioni Istituzionali

Le collaborazioni con società scientifiche, università e gruppi ospedalieri sono il cuore della
nostra missione per innovare la simulazione medica. Queste partnership ci permettono di sviluppare
programmi formativi all’avanguardia e progetti di ricerca che elevano le competenze dei
professionisti sanitari. Lavorare a stretto contatto con le realtà scientifiche più autorevoli ci
consente di garantire una formazione di eccellenza, che fonde teoria e pratica in un ambiente di
apprendimento stimolante e sicuro, sempre in linea con le ultime evidenze e innovazioni del settore.

## Apprendi, Esercitati, Migliora.

Specialisti nella crescita delle competenze

La nostra offerta formativa è pensata per chi desidera trarre il meglio dai percorsi educativi e
potenziare le proprie competenze, per garantire la massima sicurezza dei pazienti. Ogni corso è
progettato per offrire non solo **crediti formativi ECM**, ma anche un **apprendimento altamente
interattivo**, mirato e all’avanguardia.

**Andiamo oltre la teoria**: grazie alla simulazione, offriamo la possibilità di sperimentare
procedure in modo realistico, perfezionare ogni gesto in un ambiente controllato per imparare a
prendere decisioni critiche sotto pressione. La simulazione è l’unica tecnica che riproduce
fedelmente le dinamiche e le sfide dei contesti reali, **con la possibilità di sbagliare, correggere
e migliorare senza conseguenze**.

## La nostra tecnologia al servizio della formazione

Ricerca, sviluppo e servizi per la simulazione avanzata

La simulazione avanzata è la nuova frontiera dell’addestramento in medicina. Offriamo soluzioni
all’avanguardia per la simulazione medica, pensate per potenziare le competenze dei professionisti
sanitari, garantire cure di eccellenza e contribuire alla sicurezza dei pazienti. Grazie
all’esperienza maturata in oltre 15 anni di attività, siamo esperti nella progettazione e gestione
integrata dei centri di simulazione per formazione continua dei professionisti sanitari. Offriamo
soluzioni personalizzate e studiate su misura per le esigenze di ciascun cliente. Grazie al nostro
team di ricerca e sviluppo, impegnato ogni giorno per migliorare i prodotti e i servizi,
contribuiamo a ridefinire gli standard della simulazione medica a livello internazionale.

### Collaborazioni Istituzionali

Le collaborazioni con società scientifiche, università e gruppi ospedalieri sono il cuore della
nostra missione per innovare la simulazione medica. Queste partnership ci permettono di sviluppare
programmi formativi all’avanguardia e progetti di ricerca che elevano le competenze dei
professionisti sanitari. Lavorare a stretto contatto con le realtà scientifiche più autorevoli ci
consente di garantire una formazione di eccellenza, che fonde teoria e pratica in un ambiente di
apprendimento stimolante e sicuro, sempre in linea con le ultime evidenze e innovazioni del settore.

# Simulation-centric In-person and Virtual Learning Journeys

Advantexe is a global & award-winning talent development firm leveraging the power of cloud-based,
digital business simulations to support the transfer of knowledge and new skills back to the job -
Call (610) 828-8707 to learn more

## Strategic Initiatives

[business-acumen-image]

Build the skills to develop a more systemic view of business so that your employees can improve
decision-making that will impact your company's bottom line.

[[Learn More]][80]

[leadership-development-icon]



Develop your leaders so they can build and sustain a high-performing organization that provides a
healthy return to your investors.

 

[[Learn More]][82]

Strengthen the skills your sales professionals need to better understand their customers from a
business perspective and to more effectively position the value of your solution.

investment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

store online via the X-node Hub.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

#### Introducing the new Vista 300 patient monitor

An essential patient monitor for adults, paediatrics, and neonates. It is part of a scalable patient
monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access
and optimise your workflows.

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

## Who We Serve

### [**Full Code for Individuals**][58]

Strengthen and expand your knowledge and clinical skills in a judgment-free space. Adjust the
difficulty level from novice to expert to find the leading edge of your performance.

### [**Full Code for Educators**][59]

Whether teaching students or practicing professionals, educators can exponentially expand simulation
training and assessment in their curricula. Using our case library and dashboard, you will improve
your curriculum and reduce your workload with the scientifically-proven cognitive benefits* of the
Full Code platform.

**Low et al. J Educ Eval Health Prof. 2024;21:33. doi: 10.3352/ jeehp.2024.21.33; PMID: 39552082*

### Content by Clinicians

clinician-educators.

Fathom.ai
Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

including AI-generated captions and clip extraction from long-form video. The company was founded in
May 2023 by David Zitoun and his co-founder, and is headquartered in France with most of its revenue
coming from the United States. Zitoun serves as Co-Founder and CEO and runs the company with a team
of 13 people. SubMagic reached $1M ARR exactly three months after acquiring its first customer in
May 2023, hitting that milestone on August 1, 2023. By June 2025, the company had grown to $8M ARR,
fully bootstrapped with no outside funding. The company sees between 5,000 and 10,000 new signups
per day, converted roughly 2,500 new paid customers in its most recent month, and carries a monthly
logo churn rate of approximately 15%. Its affiliate program, which pays 30% of lifetime customer
value, accounts for more than 10,000 active affiliates and directly drives 20% of total revenue. The
single most striking strategic fact is that SubMagic scaled from zero to $8M ARR in two years with
13 employees, generating roughly $700,000 of revenue per employee, by combining precise timing with
the short-form content boom, a generous affiliate program launched within 30 days of its first
customer, and a relentless focus on a three-click product experience rather than paid acquisition.

marketing and sales and Dylan owning product, and the company has scaled to $1 million in revenue
per employee while building an internal army of roughly 100 AI agents in Gumloop to automate growth

Developers and Subject Matter Experts work in conjunction to create innovative learner-centric,
interactive  learning solutions to craft top-quality corporate training/E-Learning to drive
productivity throughout your business.

offers an excellent selection of programs for up-skilling and re-skilling across different
professions. We provide end-to-end content and design solutions for academic and corporate learning.

content creation . We are also an IBM Silver Partner.

We are proud to be India partners for Voxy – One of the world’s leading and most innovative English
learning program designed for tomorrow’s professionals.

Designed for simulation leaders, educators and researchers who want to develop and maintain
high-quality healthcare simulation programs within their organizations.

[ View Training Courses ][57]

Healthcare Systems, Hospitals, and Health Professions Schools can redefine their approach to
performance, safety, and team well-being.

[ Learn More ][58]

The Healthcare Simulation Essentials course is led by experienced simulation educators and covers
all high-level elements and concepts involved in running a simulation program.

[ Learn More ][59]

Workshops for practicing clinicians that address the clinical and behavioral aspects of individual
and team performance with a focus on crisis management and error prevention.

[ View Training Courses ][60]

CMS’ DASH^{©} Training Workshop gives you tips and techniques from the team that created the tool.
Develop yourself, your peers, and your program’s debriefing power with DASH Training from CMS.

[ Apply Today ][61]

We provide world-renowned healthcare simulation programs for a broad spectrum of providers and
applications. Be prepared for real-life situations by training with CMS.

# Simulate Real Medical Procedures Before They Happen

### We help medical device companies and healthcare teams test, train, and validate procedures using
### realistic simulation environments.

[ Contact Us ][75]

## Bridging the Gap Between
## Lab Testing and Clinical Reality

Developing and validating medical devices involves significant cost, time, and uncertainty. Most
devices are tested in simplified lab setups or directly in costly and risky real-world environments.

HumanX provides realistic, controllable simulation environments that allow you to test, train, and
validate procedures before they happen.

## From Concept to
## Realistic Simulation

Every device and application is different. That’s why
we work closely with your team to define the right simulation approach—based on your device, your
procedure, and your goals.

From initial concept to fully functional simulation setup, we create environments that reflect
real-world conditions and deliver measurable value in testing, training, and validation.

[HumanX Medical Training Model for Cystoscopy]
[HumanX Medical Training Model for Arthroscopy]

## Trusted by Leading Medical Device Companies

#### Selected clients and collaboration partners

With over 20 years of experience in medical simulation and training, we bring proven expertise from
hundreds of **custom-built models and simulators** developed in close collaboration with leading
MedTech companies, hospitals, and research institutions.
* Proven experience in device testing and simulation
* Realistic and application-specific environments
* Used globally in R&D, training, and product demonstration
* ### Do you operate a simulation facility?
  
  No — we provide the systems that enable simulation in your own environment.
* ### How is this different from cadaver or animal testing?
  
  Cadaver and animal models provide biological realism but are limited, costly, and not easily
  repeatable.
  Our simulation environments offer a controllable, reusable, and application-specific alternative,
  allowing you to test and train under consistent conditions without regulatory or logistical
  constraints.
* ### Can setups be customized for our device?
  
  Yes. Every simulation environment is tailored to your specific device, procedure, and objectives.
  We design and build setups that reflect your real-world application as closely as possible.
* ### Can simulation setups be used for product demonstrations?
  
  Yes. Our systems are frequently used by medical device companies for realistic and compelling
  product demonstrations in training, sales, and marketing environments.
* ### How long does it take to develop a system?
  
  Case-related training models are usually shipped within 48 hours.

### Reusable & Remoldable

Rated for 8 to 10 remelts while maintaining calibration. Shelf-stable, no refrigeration required.
Reduces per-session material cost by up to 80% compared to single-use alternatives.

### Controlled Tissue Behavior

Six formulations spanning a calibrated compliance range, from baseline resistance to ultra-soft.
Each delivers predictable mechanical response for its intended application.

### Validated Acoustic Response

Acoustic properties characterized across clinical ultrasound frequencies (3 to 10 MHz). Supports
consistent imaging behavior with linear, curvilinear, and phased array probes.

### Repeatable Performance

Every SimuGel batch is compression and needle tested. Results are documented on a Certificate of
Analysis shipped with each order, so performance is consistent across every use.

## Engineered Tissue. Built for Simulation.

Humimic Medical develops synthetic tissue materials used in simulation and testing environments
worldwide. The SimuGel platform supports device R&D, clinical training, ultrasound imaging, and
research applications. 

### Application-Driven Design

SimuGel formulations are developed for specific use cases, from vascular access training to device
validation to ultrasound imaging. Each is selected by tissue behavior, not material weight.

### Responsive Technical Support

Our team supports formulation selection, reference kit ordering, and custom development inquiries.
Response within one business day.

### Custom Development Capability

Custom simulation models and device testing substrates built to your specifications. From prototype
to production, using SimuGel synthetic tissue throughout.

### One Platform, Every Application

Consistent tissue behavior across every product, every order, every use. Every Humimic application
is built on the validated SimuGel synthetic tissue platform.

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding

[patient centered care icon]

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

DrConnect, and MyPractice.

# 4.8 billion people worldwide

are unable to obtain a simple, life-saving procedure.
[ Our Solution: Watch the Video ][19] [ French Version Fundraising Progress ][20]
95%

#### Over 95% of the population in LMICs lack access to basic surgical care.

30%

#### More than 30% of the global health burden requires surgical treatment.

0


#### Over 1.5 million lives could be saved annually by investing in basic surgical procedure
#### training.

> A lack of appropriately trained personnel is a key contributor to insufficient access to surgical
> care. The shortage has resulted in an unmanageable backlog of cases.

> New resources, technology and training programs must be developed to address the need for more
> reliable and accessible surgical care in LMICs.

> There is an immediate need to increase the number of appropriately trained, qualified health
> professionals in low and middle-income countries.

[Learn More About The Need][21]

### SIMULATION TECHNOLOGY FOR A GLOBAL SOCIETY 

> Simulation training can dramatically improve the efficiency and efficacy of medical training. It
> can also help reduce the cost and time involved with training medical professionals.

[See Our Work in Action][22]
[Learn How You Can Help][23]

### Simulation Technology: MSI’s Interactive Video Trainer

Medical Simulation International has developed an **Interactive Simulation Trainer** tool that
allows trainees the opportunity to experience and rehearse medically complex procedures on a
standard personal computer before performing them on a patient.

> “For too long, the global health movement has failed to count surgery as an integral part of
> public health.” *– Paul Farmer, in the forward to “[Essential Surgery][24]“*

### MSI Makes Medical Training Technology Accessible

Medical Simulation International (MSI) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization whose mission is to
develop and deploy novel training tools for the benefit of medical professionals in low- and
middle-income countries (LMICs). [**Learn More **][25]

anatomy solutions provide realistic, hands-on learning experiences for medical professionals and

## Where We Operate

One mission. Three key markets. Advanced medical simulation across the Americas.

### United States

Medvision serves healthcare education and medical simulation programs across the United States. Our
team works with universities, hospitals, simulation centers, EMS programs, nursing schools, and
healthcare training institutions to provide advanced medical simulators and immersive training
solutions.

### Canada

Medvision supports medical education and clinical simulation programs across Canada with innovative
healthcare training technology. Our simulation solutions help educators and healthcare professionals
enhance hands-on learning, clinical skills development, and realistic patient care training.

### Latin America

Medvision provides medical simulation and healthcare education solutions to institutions across
Latin America. We work with healthcare educators, universities, hospitals, and training centers to
expand access to advanced patient simulation, ultrasound training, anatomy education, and clinical
skills development.

## Our customers appreciate simulators

We used Leonardo for two different simulation sessions this Summer. It worked very well for lung
compliance and resistance disease scenarios. It could not be used for simulating spontaneous
breathing trials (SBI) and Rapid Shallow Breathing Indexes(RSBI).

RT department
Working with Leonardo on Ventilator
Brandon

Hi Jason, I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for taking the time to come out and set up MATT
(MedVision Auscultation Task Trainer ) at our school. The demonstration you provided was incredibly
informative, and I can already see how MATT will greatly benefit our students' training. By having
the ability to hear a variety of different breath sounds, our students will be able to enhance their
learning and improve their skills. MATT provides students with proper placement of their
stethoscopes because the auscultation points light up. This hands-on experience will undoubtedly
contribute to their development as future healthcare professionals. Thank you once again for your
support and for introducing us to this valuable educational resource. We truly appreciate your
dedication and willingness to help our students succeed. Best Regards

Jackie Holland, MHL, RRT
Program Director Respiratory Therapy
Pickens Technical College

We purchase the MATT trainer just a few years ago and our educators love it. Some of the popular
features are its ease of use for one-on-one training, visuals that aid in a larger group training
session, and the large realistic sound library. Our Techs like how easy it is set up for training
and pack away when not in use.

Jared McClure, Ed.D.
Clinical Simulation Learning Center
Mayborn College of Health Sciences

The two Matt's we purchased have been instrumental in preparing our students for live patient
interaction. MATT provides a visual understanding of the external pulmonary anatomy and the use of
correct stethoscope placement, allowing students to grasp more complexities in later courses

Douglas S.Gardenhire
International Initiatives Lewis College of Nursing and Health
Professions Georgia State University

Our University purchased the manikins in hopes of having a much more diverse looking simulators that
meet our population here in NM. Both the infant and the adult manikins. Very easy to train on and
use, customer service is spot on! Just a phone call away with excellent service. Leonardo is easy to
program and use. It is used exclusively wit out MSA Program. Mia is used for our Hospital pediatric
resident and Pediatric s fellow and simulation program.

Luke Esquibel, EMT
Education Specialist I American Red Cross Instructor Trainer
UNM Hospital-BATCAVE

We recently purchased several high-fidelity simulators and other equipment from MedVision for our
College of Nursing, and we couldn't be happier with our experience. Kate and the team were
incredibly easy to work with, providing excellent customer support throughout the entire process.
Their professionalism and dedication ensured that everything went smoothly, and the quality of the
equipment is outstanding. We highly recommend MedVision for anyone in need of top-notch medical
simulation products and exceptional service. Thanks

Michelle Julian PhD, MSN, RN
Associate Dean of Academic Affairs/Associate Professor
Ron and Kathy Assaf College of Nursing

In the past six months I have been working with the new Leonardo from MedVision. He has helped with
data acquisition, objectives and skills other high-fidelity simulators could not do, and so much
more. His realism is unmatched. I hope to highlight a few items in this letter that really stand-out
to the industry.

Adam Dodson, NRP, NCEE, CCEMTP
Operations Manager
The Johns Hopkins Medicine Simulation Center

Medvision is a global leader in medical simulation, dedicated to advancing healthcare training
through cutting-edge technology. Our high-fidelity patient simulators, ultrasound trainers, and
anatomy solutions provide realistic, hands-on learning experiences for medical professionals and
students. With a commitment to innovation and excellence, Medvision empowers educators and
institutions to enhance clinical skills, improve patient outcomes, and redefine medical training.

## Where We Operate

One mission. Three key markets. Advanced medical simulation across the Americas.

### United States

Medvision serves healthcare education and medical simulation programs across the United States. Our
team works with universities, hospitals, simulation centers, EMS programs, nursing schools, and
healthcare training institutions to provide advanced medical simulators and immersive training
solutions.

### Canada

Medvision supports medical education and clinical simulation programs across Canada with innovative
healthcare training technology. Our simulation solutions help educators and healthcare professionals
enhance hands-on learning, clinical skills development, and realistic patient care training.

### Latin America

Medvision provides medical simulation and healthcare education solutions to institutions across
Latin America. We work with healthcare educators, universities, hospitals, and training centers to
expand access to advanced patient simulation, ultrasound training, anatomy education, and clinical
skills development.

## Our customers appreciate simulators

We used Leonardo for two different simulation sessions this Summer. It worked very well for lung
compliance and resistance disease scenarios. It could not be used for simulating spontaneous
breathing trials (SBI) and Rapid Shallow Breathing Indexes(RSBI).

RT department
Working with Leonardo on Ventilator
Brandon

Hi Jason, I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for taking the time to come out and set up MATT
(MedVision Auscultation Task Trainer ) at our school. The demonstration you provided was incredibly
informative, and I can already see how MATT will greatly benefit our students' training. By having
the ability to hear a variety of different breath sounds, our students will be able to enhance their
learning and improve their skills. MATT provides students with proper placement of their
stethoscopes because the auscultation points light up. This hands-on experience will undoubtedly
contribute to their development as future healthcare professionals. Thank you once again for your
support and for introducing us to this valuable educational resource. We truly appreciate your
dedication and willingness to help our students succeed. Best Regards

Jackie Holland, MHL, RRT
Program Director Respiratory Therapy
Pickens Technical College

We purchase the MATT trainer just a few years ago and our educators love it. Some of the popular
features are its ease of use for one-on-one training, visuals that aid in a larger group training
session, and the large realistic sound library. Our Techs like how easy it is set up for training
and pack away when not in use.

Jared McClure, Ed.D.
Clinical Simulation Learning Center
Mayborn College of Health Sciences

The two Matt's we purchased have been instrumental in preparing our students for live patient
interaction. MATT provides a visual understanding of the external pulmonary anatomy and the use of
correct stethoscope placement, allowing students to grasp more complexities in later courses

Douglas S.Gardenhire
International Initiatives Lewis College of Nursing and Health
Professions Georgia State University

Our University purchased the manikins in hopes of having a much more diverse looking simulators that
meet our population here in NM. Both the infant and the adult manikins. Very easy to train on and
use, customer service is spot on! Just a phone call away with excellent service. Leonardo is easy to
program and use. It is used exclusively wit out MSA Program. Mia is used for our Hospital pediatric
resident and Pediatric s fellow and simulation program.

Luke Esquibel, EMT
Education Specialist I American Red Cross Instructor Trainer
UNM Hospital-BATCAVE

We recently purchased several high-fidelity simulators and other equipment from MedVision for our
College of Nursing, and we couldn't be happier with our experience. Kate and the team were
incredibly easy to work with, providing excellent customer support throughout the entire process.
Their professionalism and dedication ensured that everything went smoothly, and the quality of the
equipment is outstanding. We highly recommend MedVision for anyone in need of top-notch medical
simulation products and exceptional service. Thanks

Michelle Julian PhD, MSN, RN
Associate Dean of Academic Affairs/Associate Professor
Ron and Kathy Assaf College of Nursing

In the past six months I have been working with the new Leonardo from MedVision. He has helped with
data acquisition, objectives and skills other high-fidelity simulators could not do, and so much
more. His realism is unmatched. I hope to highlight a few items in this letter that really stand-out
to the industry.

Adam Dodson, NRP, NCEE, CCEMTP
Operations Manager
The Johns Hopkins Medicine Simulation Center

# The voice of the community pharmacist.

[Our mission][69]
[July 2026]

## America's Pharmacist
* Team building
* Visits that make a difference
* The independent pharmacy ecosystem
* From student to pharmacist: What comes next?

[Learn More][70]
[Today With NCPA]

## Today With NCPA

Check out our upcoming NCPA meetings and events.

[Full Calendar][71]
[Neighbors, Not Numbers]

## Neighbors, Not Numbers

When was the last time your chain-store pharmacist asked how you’re doing? Maybe you’re getting your
prescriptions from a mail-order pharmacy. How’s that relationship going? Do they know your name, or
do they treat you like a number? There’s a better experience waiting for you right around the corner
at a family-owned independent community pharmacy.

[Learn More][72]
[NCPA State Panel of Experts]

## NCPA State Panel of Experts

NCPA has assembled a diverse array of experts in different areas to assist states, based on certain
criteria, in their legislative and regulatory initiatives.

[Learn More][73]
[Long-Term Care Pharmacy]

## NCPA's LTC Division

The NCPA Long-Term Care Division is a resource and advocate for independent pharmacies in the LTC
space.

[Learn More][74]

## Member Spotlight

### I am NCPA

### Anna Dimak, PharmD

[Learn more][75]

## Value of NCPA:

NCPA’s value is both networking and advocacy. “The network across the country I’ve already made
through just a few conferences has been so worth the membership,” she says. “I have also valued
being able to advocate at a federal level at (the NCPA Congressional Pharmacy Fly-In) for the last
three years.”

For her, speaking up is part of the job. “Staying up to date with these issues and speaking up is a
priority in my day-to-day professional life,” she says.

# The voice of the community pharmacist.

[Our mission][69]
[July 2026]

## America's Pharmacist
* Team building
* Visits that make a difference
* The independent pharmacy ecosystem
* From student to pharmacist: What comes next?

[Learn More][70]
[Today With NCPA]

## Today With NCPA

Check out our upcoming NCPA meetings and events.

[Full Calendar][71]
[Neighbors, Not Numbers]

## Neighbors, Not Numbers

When was the last time your chain-store pharmacist asked how you’re doing? Maybe you’re getting your
prescriptions from a mail-order pharmacy. How’s that relationship going? Do they know your name, or
do they treat you like a number? There’s a better experience waiting for you right around the corner
at a family-owned independent community pharmacy.

[Learn More][72]
[NCPA State Panel of Experts]

## NCPA State Panel of Experts

NCPA has assembled a diverse array of experts in different areas to assist states, based on certain
criteria, in their legislative and regulatory initiatives.

[Learn More][73]
[Long-Term Care Pharmacy]

## NCPA's LTC Division

The NCPA Long-Term Care Division is a resource and advocate for independent pharmacies in the LTC
space.

[Learn More][74]

## Member Spotlight

### I am NCPA

### Anna Dimak, PharmD

[Learn more][75]

## Value of NCPA:

NCPA’s value is both networking and advocacy. “The network across the country I’ve already made
through just a few conferences has been so worth the membership,” she says. “I have also valued
being able to advocate at a federal level at (the NCPA Congressional Pharmacy Fly-In) for the last
three years.”

For her, speaking up is part of the job. “Staying up to date with these issues and speaking up is a
priority in my day-to-day professional life,” she says.

**Flexible configurations** align with your curriculum, competencies and program learning goals.

**Clinician-authored content **is grounded in evidence-based best practices.

Our Services

From onboarding and curriculum design to technical setup and faculty enablement, OMS combines
technology and partnership to deliver measurable improvement. Your simulation platform should work
for you—not add to your workload. That’s why every OMS implementation includes expert support to

# Electude Simulator Challenge

Welcome to the Electude Simulator Challenge.

[Home][1]
How good are you at troubleshooting engine management systems?
Take the challenge and develop your skills. Sign-up and try to get high score in a game that allows
you to diagnose and repair failures in three progressive levels of difficulty.

Or just try out the fully functional simulation of an internal combustion engine with control
modules, sensors, actuators and CAN network. Use the oscilloscope, diagnostic system, break-out box
and other tools to measure and analyze the system. Disconnect, remove and replace components and
wires to fix problems.

[ [محامص في الكويت] ][18]

## GPU Accelerated

## Axiom is a sparse GPU-accelerated volumetric fluid solver for computer graphics, visual effects,
## and games. What sets it apart is the ability to run true sparse simulations fully on a GPU.

## Run your Axiom simulations on the cloud using GridMarkets GPU farm services.

[
][15]

## Easy To Use Without Sacrificing Quality Or Control

Accelerate fluid simulations using modern GPUs without sacrificing control or simulation quality.
Axiom works directly inside SideFX’s Houdini using familiar nodes, workflows, and pipelines.

[GET STARTED][16]

## Production-Scale Visual Effects

## FAST

## You can iterate faster with Axiom because of its GPU acceleration and easy to use toolset.

## SCALABLE

## Axiom can be used for small background effects all the way up to large hero effects.

## PROVEN

## Tested by professionals to give incredible results in a fraction of the time, Axiom is being used
## on productions globally. 

Axiom Scales Well

Between Resolutions

Design the shots without waiting and then take a break to simulate the high resolution version.

### HI-RES SIM (250M VOXELS)

### LOW-RES SIM (25M VOXELS)

###### FEATURED ARTISTS

##### TESTIMONIALS

"Working primarily for episode TV with very fast turn-arounds, we need an efficient solution for
fire, smoke, and explosions within Houdini. Axiom was the perfect fit for a modern, GPU-centric VFX
facility. It is used by multiple artists in our facility daily and has replaced any other fluid sim
solutions simply by delivering what we wanted in much less time."

### Stefan Bredereck

3 time Emmy nominated 3D Supervisor & Lead TD at Muse VFX in Hollywood

"I can't even remember what life was like before Axiom, and I don't want to. You are getting render
ready resolutions in almost real time which makes me feel like an actual artist again because its
allows me to focus on the look and development of my smoke/fire instead of tweaking a setting and
waiting 2 hours to see each result. If you are ready to take your Pyro to the next level, Axiom is
exactly what you will need to do it!"

### Jordan Allen

VFX Artist at Corridor Digital

"I have been exclusively using Axiom for the past few years on big Holywood productions and I'm not
going back."

### Fabian Nowak

VES Winning VFX Artist

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

virtual medical equipment.

* [Compact Core™][24] provides the platform for integrating disparate medical simulators across
  physical and virtual simulations.

  learners to train in-person and/or via joint training sessions from remote locations using their
  own PCs.

innovative Family of Systems (FoS) team-training architecture with interoperable networked
peripherals including manikins, part-task trainers, 3D virtual patients, environmental effects, and
virtual medical equipment.  

Vcom3D’s immersive blended reality systems engage participants, assess learner and team performance,
and enable continuous improvement of learning outcomes and better clinical outcomes.
